caveats.text: The MOCCAE Model Veterinary Health Certificate is completed and USDA-VS endorsed outside Petra (Phase 2); Petra records that it was accepted, not that Petra issued it.
The MOCCAE import permit and the port-of-entry release inspection are MOCCAE's own external process; Petra records that you applied, not that MOCCAE approved or released the animal.

requirements.title: 21-day wait after a primary or lapsed rabies vaccination
Rabies antibody titre (RNATT ≥ 0.5 IU/mL), ≤12 months before travel
MOCCAE Model Veterinary Health Certificate (USDA-VS endorsed, ≤10 days)

manual_checklist.title: Apply for the MOCCAE import permit
manual_checklist.detail: Online via the ministry portal before arrival. Pay the fee (AED 200 per head) and keep the permit (copy presented on arrival). The permit is valid for 90 days — apply close enough to travel that it hasn't lapsed, but early enough to clear before departure. Pets fly as manifested cargo.

manual_checklist.title: Animals must be at least 15 weeks old
manual_checklist.detail: Younger pets are refused. (This is 15 weeks, not 4 months — the rabies vaccination + 21-day titre timing pushes the practical minimum higher.) Confirm your pet meets this age before travel; Petra does not block readiness on age itself.

manual_checklist.title: Parasite treatment within 14 days, recorded on the certificate
manual_checklist.detail: Internal + external parasite treatment within 14 days of travel, noted on the MOCCAE health certificate.

manual_checklist.title: Annual import quota: max 2 pets
manual_checklist.detail: MOCCAE limits non-commercial pet imports to 2 animals per person per year. Confirm this trip doesn't exceed your annual quota; Petra does not track imports across trips or owners.

manual_checklist.title: Check the banned-breeds list
manual_checklist.detail: Pit-bull-type breeds and some others are refused entry to the UAE. Confirm your dog's breed is not on the restricted list; Petra has no breed data to check this itself.

manual_checklist.title: No rabies booster given after the titre was drawn
manual_checklist.detail: If a rabies booster was given after the RNATT titre sample was drawn, the titre is invalidated and must be re-drawn (≥365-day validity applies only while the vaccination that was current at draw time remains current, with no intervening booster). Confirm no booster has been given since the titre sample; Petra does not track vaccination-vs-titre sequencing after the fact.

manual_checklist.title: No mixing with other pet animals in transit
manual_checklist.detail: If the shipment transits through another country, it must not mix with other pet animals during transit. Confirm your routing meets this; Petra does not track transit routing or mixing.

manual_checklist.title: Bengal/Serval cats: fifth-generation pedigree certificate
manual_checklist.detail: Bengal and Serval cats require a fifth-generation pedigree certificate to enter the UAE. Confirm this applies/is on hand if your cat is one of these breeds; Petra has no breed data to check this itself.
